About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: Our Story & Leadership
About.visionDesc1: While the core mission of AABP centers on facilitating networking opportunities and professional development, its impact extends significantly to the realms of medical science, natural science, life science, social science, and engineering.
About.visionDesc2: Through its commitment to empowering members, especially young professionals, with guidance, support, and resources, the AABP's goal is to enhance skills and knowledge across various sectors.
About.missionP1: While the core mission of AABP centers on facilitating networking opportunities and professional development, its impact extends significantly to the realms of medical science, natural science, life science, social science, and engineering.
About.missionP2: Through its commitment to empowering members, especially young professionals, with guidance, support, and resources, the AABP's goal is to enhance skills and knowledge across various sectors.
About.event1Desc: A group of Azerbaijan professionals in London founded the Association to connect and support professionals across the UK and Azerbaijan.
About.event2Desc: AABP expanded its membership across medical science, natural science, life science, social science, and engineering sectors.
About.event3Desc: Launched regular networking events, professional development programmes, and collaborative opportunities for members.
About.event4Desc: Unveiled the new digital platform to better serve our growing community of Azerbaijani-British professionals.
About.historyP1: The Association of Azerbaijani British Professionals began as a small initiative in London to connect local experts, and has since blossomed into a global powerhouse representing thousands of professionals across various sectors.
About.historyP2: Our growth is a testament to the dedication of our members and the enduring bonds between the UK and Azerbaijan. Below is a timeline of our most significant milestones.
About.leadershipDesc: The Board of Directors is the driving force behind AABP, responsible for setting our strategic direction, organizing our flagship events, and ensuring that our members receive the highest quality of professional support. Comprising leaders from diverse sectors, our board is united by a shared dedication to fostering excellence.
About.heroQuote: Empowering the next generation of leaders.
About.value1Desc: Striving for the highest standards in professional and academic achievements.
About.value2Desc: Fostering teamwork and partnerships between the UK and Azerbaijan.
About.value3Desc: Encouraging forward-thinking ideas and solutions across all industries.
About.value4Desc: Building a network that transcends borders and makes a worldwide difference.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.sec1Desc: The Association of Azerbaijani British Professionals (AABP) collects information that you provide directly to us when you register for an account, apply for membership, register for events, or communicate with us. This may include your name, email address, professional title, company, phone number, and any other information you choose to provide.
Privacy.sec2Desc: We use the information we collect to operate and improve our platform, process your membership application, manage your event registrations, communicate with you about our services, and foster networking opportunities among our members.
Privacy.sec3Desc: As a networking organization, certain information in your profile may be visible to other registered members through our Member Directory. We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share information with service providers who perform services on our behalf.
Privacy.sec4Desc: We take reasonable measures to help protect your personal information from loss, theft, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. However, no internet transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your data.
Privacy.sec5Desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at contact@aabporg.uk.
